title: O3-LSM: Maximizing Disaggregated LSM Write Performance via Three-Layer Offloading
bound_sents: In addition, we also evaluate dLSM [cite] (a fully in-memory LSM-KVS on RDMA-based DM) and use it as a performance upper-bound baseline (i.e., it is non-persistent and expected to achieve the best performance with RDMA-based DM).
Compared with dLSM, O$^3$-LSM achieves up to 11\% of the upper bound black (2.24 Mops at 64B and 1.25 Mops at 1024B) .
